text:
alex: Quick heads-up — canary r2 (traffic 5%) shows 3x 5xxs on long-context paths. Need rollback procedure that preserves KV consistency and avoids session losses. Thoughts? :rotating_light:
tina: I can flip traffic back now. What's our safe unwind? Fast revert + background KV sweep?
priya: Prefer two-step: 1) freeze canary (stop new sessions), 2) migrate existing sessions off gracefully, 3) flip split. Avoid full KV purge.
marco: Agree. Also need to rewarm prefix caches on primary after flip. If we drop keys client-side, cold start will spike latency.
alex: Proposed commands: `/rollouts/:id/freeze` then `rollouts.flip --from=canary --to=primary --percent=100` — is that the API? @jamie?
jamie: API is `POST /api/rollouts/{id}/action` with body "{\"action\":\"freeze\"}" then `POST ... {\"action\":\"promote\"}`. Console has a 'fast revert' button that does both + traffic flips but doesn't touch KV.
priya: Important: console 'fast revert' currently doesn't trigger KV rebinds for session affinity. Need a step to update session routing TTL & sticky cookie domain.
yuki: Ops playbook: run freeze, then set traffic split to 0/100, then run `kv-sync --prefetch --keys=prefix:* --target=primary` to prefill hot keys. Then TTL sweep: `kv-ttl-check --grace=60m --delete-stale=false`.
tina: Who runs prefill? automation or manual? We should avoid manual ops during oncall.
marco: Automation via infra job `rollout-guard` can do prefill but needs feature flag. For now, ops-run with runbook.
ops-bot: Deploy monitor: canary r2 traffic reduced to 0% by jamie at 1951234576.
alex: OK. Quick revert play: freeze, promote, prefill job triggered async, monitor error rate to <0.5%, then run kv-ttl-sweep after 2 hours.
priya: Add telemetry checks: per-route 5xx rate, avg tail latency, kv-misses. If prefill fails, we fallback to route-level rate limit to protect primaries.
jamie: I'll update the console tooltip to surface 'prefill + sticky cookie' checkbox for fast revert. Filing a ticket.
jamie: ticket: INF-2394 — console: include kv-prefill toggle for fast revert.
alex: thanks. @tina can you run the prefill runbook and confirm when done? If anything blocks, ping me and I'll cut the cutover.
